site.title: Quoc Hung BUI
site.description: Quoc-Hung Bui is an AI researcher working on reinforcement learning, adaptive learning systems, and computer vision.

hero.title: Researching adaptive learning systems for partial and changing information.
hero.description: I work on reinforcement learning, adaptive memory, representation learning, and computer vision, with supporting interests in scientific computing and reliable learning systems.

projects.title: 3D-First MetaDrive Baseline
projects.description: A reproducible autonomous-driving study in the MetaDrive simulator. The vehicle learns from LiDAR and navigation state, with standard PPO compared against recurrent PPO with LSTM memory. The repository also includes IDM demonstrations, evaluation on unseen road scenarios, and driving replay tools.
projects.approach: LiDAR and navigation state · PPO and recurrent PPO · held-out road scenarios
projects.result: A controlled simulator study of memory and generalization for autonomous driving.

artifact.alt: Animated top-down replay of an autonomous vehicle driving in the MetaDrive simulator
artifact.caption: Top-down replay from the best locally reproduced PPO checkpoint on a held-out scenario.

projects.title: CarRacing Research Sandbox
projects.description: A research sandbox for testing adaptive memory and PPO-style agents on changing control problems, including CarRacing. It contains benchmark configurations, recurrent and feed-forward baselines, training plots, evaluation tools, and gameplay-recording utilities.
projects.approach: Continuous-control PPO · adaptive memory experiments · recorded gameplay
projects.result: A reusable environment for comparing memory mechanisms under changing visual control conditions.

artifact.alt: CarRacing gameplay from the best locally reproduced continuous-action PPO checkpoint
artifact.caption: Stochastic gameplay from the best locally reproduced continuous-action PPO checkpoint.

projects.title: Adaptive Memory Traces
projects.description: Research on how agents adapt to non-stationary dynamics under partial observability, using exponential memory traces, drift monitoring, and controlled experiments.
projects.approach: PPO · exponential feature traces · recurrent and frame-history controls
projects.result: Local replays make the learned behavior inspectable across Position-Only CartPole and Pendulum tasks.

artifacts.alt: AMT agent balancing a pole in the partially observable Position-Only CartPole benchmark
artifacts.caption: Position-Only CartPole — deterministic replay from the best-evaluation checkpoint of a full local AMT reproduction.

artifacts.alt: AMT agent controlling a pendulum while observing position without angular velocity
artifacts.caption: Position-Only Pendulum — deterministic replay from the best-evaluation checkpoint of a full local AMT reproduction.

projects.title: Nonlinear Schrödinger Equations
projects.description: Numerical comparison of full PDE simulations with an ODE model derived from the Non-Conservative Variational Approximation for soliton dynamics.
projects.approach: PDE simulation · variational reduction · trajectory comparison
projects.result: A numerical study of when a reduced dynamical model tracks the full wave simulation.

artifact.alt: PDE and NCVA ODE comparison plots

projects.title: Numerical Differentiation
projects.description: FFT-based derivatives for real and complex functions, checked against exact derivatives and finite-difference references with saved plots.
projects.approach: Spectral differentiation · real and complex test functions · reference checks
projects.result: A compact numerical-methods study with reproducible error and derivative visualizations.

projects.title: RGB-D Pose Estimation
projects.description: A classical end-to-end RGB-D baseline for rigid-part detection and 6-DoF pose estimation. It combines colour and depth clustering with geometric pose hypotheses, trimmed ICP refinement, and depth and silhouette verification against a CAD model.
projects.approach: RGB-D segmentation · CAD geometry · ICP refinement · silhouette verification
projects.result: A transparent geometric baseline whose predicted masks, axes, and pose checks can be inspected directly.

artifact.alt: Predicted object silhouettes and 6-DoF pose axes on a held-out RGB-D validation scene
artifact.caption: End-to-end baseline predictions on the strongest clean held-out validation scene; coloured outlines and axes are model outputs.

experience.description: Researched and built computer-vision systems for eKYC, including liveness and deepfake analysis, document detection and classification, image-quality modelling, and vision-language OCR experiments.
Built research data pipelines, LLM-based market-signal workflows, scalable backtesting infrastructure, trade monitoring, and numerical methods for strategy allocation and hedging.
Developed semantic-search benchmarks and query-processing models for Vietnamese media discovery, then optimized model inference for deployment.
Experimented with self-supervised image retrieval, embedding indexes for small e-commerce datasets, and language-model fine-tuning for social-media sentiment analysis.
